title: Real Girl 2
synopsis:
The popular Iroha Igarashi and reclusive Hikari Tsutsui continue to navigate the tumultuous waters of young love and what it means to be true to yourself. As their relationship grows and deepens, new and difficult challenges threaten to break them apart. While they are committed to overcoming everything that comes their way as a couple, somethings may be too much for them to conquer.

(Source: Anime News Network)

episodes.title: Regarding the Time We Put One Foot in the Normie World.
episodes.synopsis: Nothing can save Tsutsui from the normie event of the season: The Culture Festival. Will the gang be able to pull it together to have an event to remember?

episodes.title: Regarding the Time We Had Important Roles in the School Festival.
episodes.synopsis: The Culture Festival is in full swing, which means the gang must step up to the plate and make sure the whole school has a good time, no matter how awkward it may be.

episodes.title: Regarding My Unforseen Family Crisis.
episodes.synopsis: Hikari welcomes the return of normalcy with sweet relief, but it doesn’t last after he finds his dad at a cafe with a woman who isn’t his mom.

episodes.title: Regarding the Untold Story of My Parents' Courtship.
episodes.synopsis: Tsutsui's family is at a crossroads. Some families can survive betrayals, but others cannot. One thing remains clear though: Trust isn't so easily repaired once broken.

episodes.title: Regarding Miss Ayado’s New Mental Anguish.
episodes.synopsis: When Ayado’s manga-inspired fantasies derail her date with Ito, she realizes dating in 3D is a lot more complicated than it looks.

episodes.title: Regarding the Courtship of My Female Friend Ishino.
episodes.synopsis: Ishino has finally scored a date with Takanashi! But they aren’t the only ones visiting the aquarium this afternoon…

episodes.title: Regarding the Troubling Invitation from My Girlfriend.
episodes.synopsis: Why has Ito gone to Takanashi for advice? Shouldn’t he be asking Tsutsui for help, instead? They’re best friends, after all, and — wait, Ito asked Takanashi about WHAT?

episodes.title: Regarding When my Friend and my Maybe Friend Became Official.
episodes.synopsis: When Takanashi’s mother is hospitalized, Ishino steps in to help cook dinner. She means well, but will Takanashi just see this as more of Ishino’s meddling?

episodes.title: Regarding My Choice to Have No Regrets in My High School Life.
episodes.synopsis: As college entrance exams loom large, Tsutsui’s grades begin to slip. Has he stopped caring about his future, or is something else distracting him?

episodes.title: Regarding My Thoughts on the Sacred Mysteries of Life.
episodes.synopsis: Iroha’s time with Tsutsui will come to an end in just one month — so why is she avoiding him?

episodes.title: Regarding My Last Promise to Her.
episodes.synopsis: Tsutsui has been in a rut ever since he said goodbye to Iroha. Can his friends snap him out of it before their college entrance exams?

episodes.title: Regarding Her Future and Mine.
episodes.synopsis: No matter what happens to your memory, they say the heart never forgets.
